notes.note: Reviewed the Windows fixture follow-up against terminal transport design: real synchronized ConPTY output can create more than two credit windows because of echo/repaints. Replay now ACKs each received window until the fixed captured journal end, asserts each post-ACK increment is no larger than the unchanged 128-frame credit, and retains the initial exact-window stall, >140-record premise, end/ready and SDK applied-output assertions. No product behavior or thresholds change. The earlier Windows run reached 396 records and exposed the inherited single-replenishment assumption; final platform verification is reported separately.
